contribute.heading: Contribute
contribute.body: We welcome non-commercial contributions — bug fixes, docs, translations, and careful content corrections. Please read our contributing guide on GitHub before opening a PR. License terms, attribution, and what you may (and may not) do are summarized on <openSource>Open source</openSource>. Redistributions must credit {appName} and link back to <home>munibtracker.app</home>.
